description: This file defines the EnumFunction class, a custom Twig node for handling enum-related functions within Twig templates. It includes method to compile the enum function call, ensuring proper argument validation and error handling.

classes.name: EnumFunction
classes.description: A class extending FunctionExpression to handle enum-related function calls in Twig templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the enum function node, validating arguments and generating code to invoke the enum constant.
